description: Construct a full ternary or quaternary Huffman tree and return its weighted external path length.

source.title: k-ary Huffman coding
source.reference: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures, entry definition
source.pinned_behavior: Repeatedly join k least-weight trees into a k-ary tree; each level contributes one k-ary code symbol.
source.scope_note: This profile accepts only leaf counts that form a full k-ary tree and inserts no padding leaves.

input.validation_order: Validate non-null framing, exact length, arity, count, full-tree congruence, and weight bounds before returning the weighted cost.

output.meaning: Minimum sum of each input weight times its leaf depth in k-ary digits.

workspace.accounting: At most 13 tree roots/nodes, their i64 weights and stable IDs, plus scan and merge scalars; input is caller-owned.

complexity.primary_time: O(n^2) by repeated scans for the k smallest active roots
complexity.independent_time: O(S*n), where S is the number of full ordered k-ary shapes (at most 55 for k=3,n<=10 and 22 for k=4,n<=10)
complexity.independent_auxiliary_space: O(n) per recursive shape generation path, plus the bounded shape list

oracle_method: The primary sums each newly-created parent weight during stable k-way Huffman merging. The independent reference enumerates full ordered k-ary tree shapes, assigns the largest weights to the shallowest leaves, and minimizes the resulting cost.
